research_notes: Initial review2026-10-01 covers frozen record, first speech, government biography, charity employer annual report, contemporary corporate ownership filings and host account. Early hospitality/insurance/fast-food/fitness work and Robe River were absent from frozen list and retained without invented dates.

Follow-up: UK employment and relation to other undated roles; early employer names and payroll control; Robe River dates/title; legal practice firm-by-firm dates/articles; CBH role transition; all substantive hours, parental/other leave and overlaps; Crosslands2012 departure and2012–13work gap; BrightSpark appointment/end/pay basis.

Searches for CBH/Crosslands individual annual-report mentions, BrightSpark appointment and full-time evidence did not resolve these gaps. Namesake US clinical executive/physician and their employment contracts excluded. Broad20/30-year experience claims not a calculable full-time history.

Periods remain year precision except Cancer Council month endpoints. UK ten-year narrative may overlap other identified roles and is retained as a lead, not a duplicate additive spell. Charity board terms excluded even where they overlap Parliament.
